Senior Java Engineer
Build the services. Own the outcome.
A concurrency bug that only appears under real load. A service that must stay available when a
dependency fails. Privacy guarantees that have to hold in production. These are the kinds of problems you will work through in this Java assignment.
Join 2MNordic for a long-term client assignment in a small, autonomous engineering team. 
Own services from design through production, influence the technical approach and build frameworks used across teams and by the developer community.
Why this role is worth your attention
• Ownership from design to production. Take a goal, work out the approach and see your service through delivery.
• Depth beyond the framework. Work with Java concurrency, memory behaviour and performance under real production load.
• Decisions with consequences. Design for availability, security and distributed failure modes, with privacy central to the system.
• Time to go deep. A long-term assignment gives you room to understand the domain and improve the services you build.
What you will build and improve
• Customer-facing web services that handle authentication, authorisation, spam control and demanding availability requirements.
• REST services using Netty or similar frameworks, backed by storage and caching technologies such as Cassandra, Redis and memcached.
• Distributed services designed around consistency, partitioning and failure recovery.
• Shared frameworks and reliable releases supported by automated testing and CI/CD.
How the team works
You will work across teams, manage dependencies and make technical decisions others can follow.
Priorities evolve as capabilities, security considerations and partner needs change. You should be comfortable adapting the plan, challenging assumptions and protecting quality as you do.

Bring your engineering judgement
You have built and scaled services for real users, debugged production failures and learned from the results. Typically, that means five or more years of experience; the depth of your work matters more than the number.
• Deep Java knowledge: the memory model, garbage collection behaviour and tuning, allocation pressure and java.util.concurrent beyond synchronised blocks. You can explain when to use virtual threads versus classic reactive models.
• Production debugging: experience investigating problems that only appear under real load or concurrency, and reading dependency source code when documentation is no longer enough.
• Service engineering: authentication, authorisation, availability, abuse prevention, reliability and performance tuning under load.
• Distributed systems and data: sound reasoning about consistency, partitioning and failure modes, plus strong knowledge of Cassandra, Redis, memcached or comparable technologies.
• Reliable delivery: REST services with Netty or similar frameworks, automated testing and CI/CD tooling.
• Clear communication in English: explain technical decisions to engineers and non-engineers, write useful design documents and work through trade-offs across teams.
Experience that adds value
Cryptography knowledge is particularly valuable: PKCS, KMIP, X.509, AES, key derivation functions and certificate authorities. Key handling and privacy guarantees are central to the system.
Experience with ML systems, frameworks or algorithms is a bonus, as is familiarity with GitHub, Maven, Docker, Spinnaker and Kubernetes.
Your consultancy partner: 2MNordic
Founded in Sweden in 2001, 2MNordic helps companies turn technological complexity into operational capability. Our work spans software development, architecture, automation, AI and data.
This assignment brings that approach to hands-on backend engineering with our client in Malmö.
Explore our work at 2mnordic.com.
Let your work start the conversation

Location matters: this is an onsite assignment in Malmö. Include your current location and whether you can commute or relocate. The working language is English.

Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As our Creator Marketing Coordinator, you will play a key role in the day-to-day execution of influencer marketing campaigns across multiple markets. Working closely with creator marketing specialists, agencies, creators, and internal stakeholders, you'll help ensure campaigns are delivered smoothly, on time, and aligned with our creative and business objectives. This is a hands-on coordination role suited for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities at once and solving challenges along the way. 
Take part in the planning, organization, and execution of creator marketing campaigns.  
Ensure all necessary materials and assets are provided to creators and agencies, and campaigns are launched on schedule. Review influencer content to ensure it meets brand guidelines and campaign objectives before publishing.  
Serve as the primary point of contact between the brand, agencies, and creators. Manage communications, briefings, and approvals, ensuring expectations and timelines are clear and adhered to.  
Monitor and support live campaigns, helping track campaign performance and key metrics while identifying opportunities for optimization and improvement.   
Assist in managing campaign budgets, tracking expenses, and ensuring cost-effective use of resources. Liaise with finance and legal teams on contracts and payments as needed.  
Maintain and nurture relationships with creators, ensuring they feel supported and motivated to deliver their best work for the brand. Assist in identifying new creators for future partnerships.  
Act as the first line of support to resolve any campaign-related issues that arise with influencers or agencies, from delays to miscommunications or content concerns. 
 

 
WHO YOU ARE  
We are looking for people with…  
Experience working with influencer marketing, creator partnerships, social media campaigns or similar marketing activations in the US, with great understanding of SoMe platforms such as TikTok and Instagram.   
Passionate about staying up to date with social media trends and a strong understanding of the younger audience and what creates engaging activations.   
Comfortable working with campaign data, reporting, and performance tracking.   
Experience working with the US market and/or exposure to affiliate marketing are considered advantages.   
Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.   
 

And people who are…  
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly. You are proactive, solution-oriented and enjoy finding ways to make things happen.   
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Able to structure and manage large volumes of deliverables, parallel campaigns, and reporting thereof.  
You thrive while juggling multiple projects and deliverables at the same time, maintaining calm and good judgment. 
 

 
WHO WE ARE  
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter.  
 
JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  
This is a full-time permanent position based in Stockholm. Please apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page.

Vi söker legitimerad lärare i fritidshem - Vikariat 20270107 - 20271220

IES i Landskrona öppnades 2017, och är en F-9 skola. Här möts dagligen närmare 600 elever samt närmare 70 medarbetare. Vi är en tvåspråkig skola, engelska-svenska, som följer den svenska läroplanen. Våra möten sker mestadels på engelska. Att jobba i vår skola är att vara del av en professionell gemenskap och samarbete.

Om tjänsten

Vill du vara med och skapa trygga, roliga och meningsfulla dagar för våra yngsta elever? Vi söker en engagerad  legitimerad lärare i fritidshem som brinner för social utveckling, rörelse och aktivitet både i klassrummet och ute på skolgården.

I den här rollen har du en central funktion under hela elevens skoldag. Ditt fokus täcker tre viktiga områden:

- Fritidshem (Placering i Förskoleklass): Du planerar och leder den pedagogiska verksamheten på fritidshemmet tillsammans med ditt arbetslag, med särskilt fokus på eleverna i förskoleklass.
- Rastverksamhet under skoltid: Du ansvarar för att strukturera, planera och genomföra aktiva och inkluderande rastaktiviteter. Du finns där som en närvarande vuxen som främjar rörelseglädje, stimulerar lek och förebygger utanförskap och konflikter.
- Samverkan i skolan: Du samverkar med klasslärare under skoltiden för att skapa en sammanhållen dag för eleverna.Vi söker dig som:

- Är legitimerad lärare i fritidshem (eller har en äldre examen som grundskollärare med inriktning mot fritidshem).
- Har ett starkt intresse för rastpedagogik och ser rasten som en viktig lärandemiljö för sociala färdigheter och trygghet.

jobs.occupation: Product Assurance Manager to Beyond Gravity Gothenburg
jobs.description:
🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​
 
About Beyond Gravity
Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1'900 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and produce solutions for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com.
 
Your crew
As a Product Assurance Manager you'll be part of the Quality Department, responsible for the development, implementation and verification of the Product Assurance requirements among entire project life. The Product Assurance Manager will act as main interface to the customer and the subcontractors for quality and safety topics. Quality Management at Beyond Gravity is all about ensuring a Learning Organization that leads the Space Industry improvement rate and garantees customer satisfaction.
 
Your mission
Develop the Product Assurance Requirements and Culture at project level, ensuring robust quality processes, cost excellence for program quality execution through collaboration with Programs, Engineering and Operations.
Act as main interface for Customer for all quality and safety topics.
Establish Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) features in collaboration with Customer and Engineering.
Lead NC and failure investigation whenever product requirements are violated.
Supervise and direct Product Development and Qualification for all relevant quality aspects.
Coordinate for all Quality matters international multi-site and cross-country programs.

 
Main Tasks:
Execute Product Assurance Program in accordance with Project Milestones.
Ensure successful execution of the Customer, Regulatory and Internal Requirements for Program Execution.
Convert the Customer Critical to Quality Requirements into internal specifications and requirements.
Lead Customer Critical RCA and investigation activities.
Moderate Design FMEA.
Develop Process/Product CTQ and Control Plans in collaboration with Customer and Engineering.
Establish Product Quality Documentation.
Support and achieve final Product Qualification.
Contribute as needed to Customer and internal Audit as Quality representative.

 
Most important output
Contribute to Customer Satisfaction for Quality Performance
Quality Milestone Achievements for Projects
Design FMEA
Product CTQs Development (Control Plans)
Product Quality data-package for Space Application
Final Product Qualification data-package for Space Application
Customer RCA and NC Report

 
Your story
Must’s:
Relevant experience in the field of Quality and Continuous Improvement
Preferred education: MSc degree in Engineering or in a similar relevant discipline
Knowledge of standards such as EN9100, ECSS, NASA and MIL
Ability to quickly understand and analyse technical products/systems and their function
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
MS Office experience required
Experience in the application of Quality preventive methodology (5Why, Ishikawa Fishbone…)

 
Nice to have’s:
Any further language (German, French and Swedish) beyond English is a strong asset
Experience in other Space companies

 
Why Beyond Gravity
To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.
You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!
 
🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​
Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​
​
For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: ​Catarina Rio |  | catarina.afonsorio@beyondgravity.com 
Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories.​
​
Applications by e-mail cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruitment agencies for this position.

ABOUT THE ROLE    

We’re looking for a BI Engineer to join our Business Intelligence Engineering team at LeoVegas Group. You’ll work across the full BI stack, from modelling data in BigQuery to building the dashboards senior leaders use to run a multi-brand, multi-jurisdiction iGaming business.
This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership. We treat our reporting as data products, built to scale and to last, and we’re moving our BI platform to Sigma, so you’ll help shape how we build on it from early on. If you enjoy writing clean SQL, solving messy data problems, and seeing your work shape decisions across the business, we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
Design, build, and maintain scalable presentation-layer datasets using SQL, dbt, Python, Airflow, and BigQuery on GCP.

Choose the right materialisation strategies and follow CI/CD practices to keep our models reliable, performant, and cost-efficient.
Design and maintain a semantic layer with governed, consistent metric definitions that power both dashboards and AI-driven self-service, so stakeholders can ask questions of the data in natural language and trust the answers.
Build interactive dashboards in Sigma, our strategic BI platform, while supporting existing Tableau reporting during the transition, working alongside Business Analysts and applying data storytelling principles that encourage self-service analytics.
Apply a data product mindset to everything you deliver, building reporting that is reusable, well-documented, and designed for long-term impact.
Partner with our Data Engineering team on upstream pipeline changes, investigate data issues through root-cause analysis, and help improve the platform we build on.
Work directly with stakeholders across Commercial, Finance, Compliance, Operations, Payments, Data Science, Marketing, and Product to understand their needs and translate them into well-designed data solutions.
Help harmonise KPIs and metric definitions across brands and BI platforms.
Champion data quality, documentation, and consistent metric definitions so people can trust what they see.
Keep learning, and share useful tools, techniques, and ideas with the team.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Essential:
2-5 years of experience in a BI Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or similar role.

Advanced SQL, with a solid grasp of data modelling concepts (for example, dimensional modelling).
Hands-on experience with at least one modern BI tool, ideally Sigma or Tableau.
The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues and senior management.
Clear, concise written documentation that others can actually use.
A structured, curious approach to problem-solving and debugging data issues.

Nice to have:
Experience in the iGaming industry (Sportsbook and/or Casino).

Python, Airflow, and dbt.
Experience with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse, and with GCP more broadly.
Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows.
Exposure to Sigma

 
WHO WE ARE
At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.
 
BENEFITS:
Hybrid work policy

4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
30 annual vacation days
Occupational Pension
5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
Parental Leave Top-Up
Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partne
Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts
 
 

JOIN US!
In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!
Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!
 
As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

jobs.description:
Elevassistent Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna 

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Sigtuna söker nu en lugn, professionell och engagerad elevassistent för att stötta en yngre elev under skoldagen och inom fritidsverksamheten. 

På IES Sigtuna tror vi att alla elever ska ha tillgång till en trygg, strukturerad och inkluderande lärmiljö där de ges möjlighet att utvecklas både kunskapsmässigt och socialt. Vi söker därför en ansvarstagande och relationsskapande vuxen som kan ge stöd utifrån en enskild elevs behov samtidigt som elevens självständighet, delaktighet och trygghet står i centrum. 

IES Sigtuna är en tvåspråkig F–9-skola med cirka 600 elever och 65 medarbetare från hela världen. Vi följer den svenska läroplanen och erbjuder upp till 50 % undervisning på engelska. Vår skolkultur bygger på tydliga rutiner, starka relationer och ett tydligt fokus på elevernas trygghet och utveckling. 

Om tjänsten 

Som elevassistent kommer du att arbeta nära en yngre elev som är i behov av praktiskt och fysiskt stöd under skoldagen. Eleven använder rullstol och behöver stöd för att fullt ut kunna delta i undervisning, förflyttningar och skolans dagliga aktiviteter. 

Rollen innebär att stötta eleven både praktiskt och socialt under dagen med ett respektfullt, uppmuntrande och elevcentrerat förhållningssätt. En viktig del av uppdraget är att hjälpa eleven att delta så självständigt och naturligt som möjligt i skolans alla delar. 

Utöver stödet under skoldagen kommer tjänsten även att innebära stöd till eleven inom fritidsverksamheten före och/eller efter skoldagen vid behov. 

Du kommer att samarbeta nära med lärare, vårdnadshavare, fritidspersonal och elevhälsoteamet för att säkerställa att elevens skoldag blir trygg, tillgänglig och positiv. 

Arbetsuppgifter 

- Stötta eleven under lektioner, raster, förflyttningar, fritids och andra skolaktiviteter 
- Ge praktiskt och fysiskt stöd under skoldagen 
- Bidra till att lärmiljöerna är tillgängliga och välstrukturerade 
- Uppmuntra delaktighet, självständighet och positiva kamratrelationer 
- Samarbeta nära med undervisande personal, vårdnadshavare, fritidspersonal och elevhälsoteamet 
- Stödja elevens kunskapsmässiga, sociala och emotionella utveckling 
- Bidra till en lugn, trygg och inkluderande skolmiljö  

Vi söker dig som: 

- Har ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med barn och unga 
- Är lugn, tålmodig, ansvarstagande och trygg i dig själv 
- Har god förmåga att skapa professionella och förtroendefulla relationer med elever och familjer 
- Förstår vikten av inkludering, värdighet och elevens självständighet 
- Är bekväm med att ge praktiskt stöd under skoldagen 
- Kan arbeta både självständigt och som en del av ett team 
- Har god kommunikativ förmåga på både svenska och engelska då båda språken är nödvändiga i rollen  

Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med elever i behov av särskilt stöd, fysisk stödinsats eller anpassade lärmiljöer är starkt meriterande. 

Vi erbjuder 

- Ett meningsfullt och givande arbete i en stöttande skolmiljö 
- Nära samarbete med erfarna kollegor och elevhälsoteam 
- En strukturerad och professionell arbetsmiljö 
- Möjlighet till professionell utveckling och lärande 
- Chansen att göra verklig skillnad i en elevs vardag  

Läs mer om vår skola här: IES Sigtuna 

Skicka din ansökan (CV och personligt brev) via IES Careers eller direkt till skolans rekryteringsansvarig. Rekrytering sker löpande.

Communicate requirements, provide input and share knowledge with stakeholders whose activities affect vehicle uptime
Proactively ensure that projects meet Test Fleet Center requirements
Order materials and services from external partners and process related invoices.
Maintain test fleet vehicles between loan periods
Identify, lead, document and implement continuous improvements to the role and its processes

jobs.occupation: Sales Lead & Key Account Manager, Sweden
jobs.description:
Out of Eden AB represents Esse Skincare in Sweden. Esse is a professional skincare brand built on the science of the skin microbiome, barrier function and long-term skin health. Our products are sold through professional salons and selected stockists across Sweden, with support from the Esse head office in South Africa. 
The role
We are now looking for a Sales Lead & Key Account Manager to lead and develop our sales in Sweden. You will be responsible for the growth strategy for the Swedish market and the relationships with our key accounts. You will also oversee the sales work of our three Account Managers. You will be the link between the Swedish market and our head office, making sure each side knows what the other needs to grow.
The role is based in the Gothenburg area, as most of our stockists are in western Sweden. It involves regular travel across Sweden and occasional travel to South Africa. You will report to the Head of Sales.
Main responsibilities
Growth plan and strategy

Analyse sales performance by account, region and salon to identify the biggest opportunities.

Develop and run a growth plan for Sweden for the coming one to two years, with clear targets.

Present the needs of the Swedish market to head office, such as resources, stock, marketing and training, with evidence to support them.

Own the sales pipeline for Sweden and report on progress.

Key account management

Be the main contact for all key accounts in Sweden, working closely with them in person.

Agree quarterly targets with each key account and follow up on results.

Plan approved promotions and campaigns in advance and share them with the key accounts.

Make sure key accounts operate according to agreed terms and conditions.

Overseeing the Account Managers

Oversee the three Account Managers in Sweden, set priorities and follow up on sales activity against targets.

Coach the Account Managers through joint customer visits and regular follow-up.

Support the Account Managers in finding new leads, partners and salons, and in developing existing customers.

Events, education and marketing

Organise Pro Summit, our two-day sales, education and marketing event for stockists held every September.

Plan and run the yearly events calendar for Sweden, including trade shows.

Plan and deliver training for Account Managers, stockists and salon teams.

Work with accounts and salons on how Esse marketing is used locally.

New business

Lead the work of opening new salons in the region, together with the Account Managers and personally for strategic accounts.

Your profile
Requirements

Experience coaching, training or leading salespeople.

Experience selling professional skincare to salons and working with key accounts or distributors.

A background in skin education or training of skin therapists, with a solid understanding of skin science and the microbiome.

Experience of training and presenting to groups, from salon teams to larger audiences.

Experience of planning and running events.

Fluent English, spoken and written.

A driving licence (B) and the ability to travel frequently within Sweden.

Meritorious

Experience working closely with an international head office.

Knowledge of Esse products.

Swedish, or a willingness to learn.

As a person, you are a salesperson at heart and comfortable opening doors and asking for the order. You are practical and adaptable, as the role develops with what the market needs. You work well independently, far from head office, while keeping colleagues and leadership well informed.
What we offer

A central role in developing the Swedish market for an international skincare brand.

A fixed monthly salary.

Pension contributions and insurance in line with market practice.

Practical information

Employer: Out of Eden AB

Form of employment: Permanent, full-time

Location: Gothenburg area, with travel across Sweden

How to apply
Apply via the link with your CV and a short cover letter in English.
